messages:
mira.docs: Quick flag on PR #2710the embeddings batch response examples in the API ref show an array of objects with field `vector` as an array of strings. Runtime actually returns floats (numbers).

mira.docs: Example in the PR: {"id":"doc1", "vector":["0.12", "-0.34"]} but actual response: {"id":"doc1", "vector":[0.12, -0.34]}

leo-api: Thanks, good catch. Somewhere during docs generation the example serializer coerced numeric arrays to strings. OpenAPI schema is correct (number[]), but one example file was hand-edited and persisted.

ben-sdk: This caused the Rust SDK deserialization test to fail. Rust's strict JSON -> struct mapping rejects string-in-array for floats. JS SDK tolerant, so only typed languages showed failures.

ops-bot: FYI: customer-reported dashboard (internal ticket #987) also surfaced because their ingestion pipeline parsed vectors as strings and stored them wrong.

mira.docs: Plan: I'll patch the examples in the API ref (curl/js/py/rust snippets) to make vector types explicit numbers, and add a brief note: "embeddings vectors are arrays of numbers (float)."

leo-api: I'll also regenerate the examples from the OpenAPI canonical examples and remove the hand-edited file. Will push an OpenAPI-only commit with corrected example JSON.

ben-sdk: I'll add a unit test in the Rust SDK to assert that deserializing the canonical example yields Vec<f32> and include a small migration note in the changelog. ETA: 3h.

ci-bot: CI: docs PR #2710 lint OK, integration tests failing: rust-sdk/DeserializeEmbeddingsExample (see https://ci.internal/rdw/2710/job/56).

leo-api: Action items: 1) @leo-api remove hand-edited example and regen 2) @mira.docs update API ref and snippets + short FAQ blurb 3) @ben-sdk add deserialization test and changelog entry 4) Ops: confirm customer pipeline fix. Target: EOD.
